title: DSA - Why Bubble Sort? + Time Complexity
description:
## Why Bubble Sort?
Bubble sort is the simplest sorting algorithm. Nobody uses it in production - it's too slow. But it teaches you:
- How sorting works
- How to analyze time complexity
- Why better algorithms matter

## Time Complexity
Bubble sort has two nested loops:
- Outer loop runs n times
- Inner loop runs n times
- Total: n × n = **O(n²)**

For 10 items: 100 operations. Fine.
For 1,000 items: 1,000,000 operations. Slow.
For 1,000,000 items: 1,000,000,000,000 operations. Dead.

---
## Question:
If bubble sort takes 1 second to sort 1,000 items, roughly how long would it take to sort 10,000 items?
